modalities.A: 3 continuous outputs from affine map of q
modalities.B: 3-class probability vector from softmax affine map of q
modalities.C: 4x4 intensity image from sigmoid affine map of q

model: three modality-specific encoders -> one shared 3-node triangle core -> three modality-specific decoders
binding_objective: each observed modality must generate all three same-scene modalities; simulator latent never enters loss
shuffled_control: cross-modal targets permuted across scenes while same-modality targets remain paired
note: Acceptance thresholds were fixed for the final five-seed batch after pilot tuning; all endpoint tables retain raw metrics.
